notes: Partial, screened snapshot from cached public listings and matching profiles collected on October 12, 2026. This is NOT a verified live inventory.
Known unavailable, not-yet-available, pre-adoption, pending, and not-yet-at-shelter records are excluded. Unreadable or unmatched profiles are also excluded.
200 dog records and 139 cat records passed this source-screening filter. No unchecked cats were added to fill the requested 200.
The absence of an unavailable notice is not proof of current availability. Every record retains availability=unconfirmed and live_verified=false.
Arrival dates and a verified newest-first sort were not accessible. Records retain the observed source listing order; date_added is null.
Four cat listing pages were inaccessible, and listing pages were cached at different times; pagination is incomplete and may omit newer pets.
Every profile_url and source_url points to the animal-specific APA profile. Profile URLs were reviewed through the retrieval service, not verified by a direct live HTTP request.
Missing values are null. Missing medical disclosures do not mean healthy.
A complete current shelter export or live listing access is required to certify 200 available recent additions per species.
Trimmed to the first 100 dogs and first 100 cats in observed listing order for site use.

field_notes.null: Unknown, missing, or invalid source value; never implicitly zero or healthy.
field_notes.gender: Source Sex field, normalized to male/female/null.
field_notes.age: Estimated at source observation; total_months is suitable for numeric comparisons. Invalid 99-year source placeholder is null; age_text retains the original.
field_notes.breed: Source Looks Like label, not verified genetic ancestry.
field_notes.weight: weight_lbs is the source value; weight_kg is calculated. Zero/invalid weights are null.
field_notes.adoption_fee: adoption_fee_usd is the listed fee in USD; additional deposits or promotions are not inferred.
field_notes.status: listed means present on a retrieved listing page, not confirmed currently available.
field_notes.availability: unconfirmed for all included records. No unavailable notice was found in a readable cached profile, but present availability is not verified.
field_notes.health_conditions: Explicit source disclosures only; may describe ongoing conditions or medical history. Not a complete medical record.
field_notes.health_review: Other medical terms/care areas need review; they are not diagnoses or negative test results.
field_notes.freshness: Every bundled record is cached_unverified. retrieved_at is our collection time, not the source last-update time.
field_notes.conflicts: Listing/profile disagreements are retained. More recently crawled demographics are preferred when both are present.
field_notes.profile_url: HTTPS hyperlink to this animal's individual Austin Pets Alive! adoption profile; source_url is retained for compatibility.
field_notes.date_added: null: actual arrival/addition dates were not available.
field_notes.recency: Observed source listing positions only. rank_in_selected_species is the order within this shortlist, not a verified arrival ranking.
field_notes.availability_check: Source-screening result, not shelter confirmation; live_verified remains false.

selection.method: Keep records with a readable matching profile; exclude unavailable, pending, pre-adoption, or not-yet-at-shelter notices; select up to 200 per species in observed listing order.
selection.limitation: This shortlist removes known negative availability signals, but cached pages cannot prove present availability. Unknown live status remains unconfirmed; no adoption dates are invented.
